headline: Treasury to hold one auction and one direct sale tomorrow
summary: The Ministry of Treasury and Finance will hold one auction and one direct sale tomorrow. The auction includes a 2-year fixed-coupon bond with an 18.4% coupon paid every six months.
why: Government bond auctions set borrowing costs and signal market demand for sovereign debt. Turkish bond yields matter for the lira and local financial conditions.
